summary: Test drives real buildContext over seven independent fixture roots: markers on //, #, --, % and a configured non-default leader each resolve a bare annotation to a distinct canonical ID (no shared-root coverage carryover), a leader-less '2119-spec:' line yields a REQ-011.4.4 violation with nothing covered, and a cross-file case proves marker scope is file-local. Mutation-tested: restricting marker leaders to //, dropping the leader check entirely, ignoring configured comment_leaders for markers, and leaking a marker into a sibling marker-less file each make this test fail.
